title: Certify an 84-bit conditional rank-seven A-stage format
body:
## Summary

Close the ordinary A-stage native-capacity part of PR3086's released producer/consumer handoff. Add only `research/rank7-native-a-format/`, with exact sources, a uniform proof, deterministic evidence and registered reproduction.

```text
64-bit normalized input components       Common grid   Common signed width
constructed gatewise C bound                11 bits          92 bits
paired Fourier bound                         7 bits          85 bits
paired Fourier + pair-first C numerators     7 bits          84 bits
```

The final separate forward/dual formats are 82/81 bits. This is an eight-bit reduction in a **sufficient arithmetic capacity bound** over identical covered values, not a measured storage/runtime saving or a new kappa. The adapter endpoint hypothesis is explicit. Scalar endpoints and exact increments, all A frame/warp endpoints, and the specified C numerator partials are covered; adapter interiors and scalar coefficient-construction microstates remain open.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3083/3084 omit native conversions; PR3086 checks one A13 boundary. **After:** both PR3076 providers and orientations cover 5,964 prelude scalars, 72 prelude warps, 4,028 A scalars, 24 A warps and 1,020 climbs each. Every changed normalized row agrees between Fraction and a separate fixed-denominator integer engine. All 1,124 frame shapes per provider and 36 rank/sign/direction C controls pass.
- Fourteen optimized behavioral groups, the registered Python 3.12 replay, byte-equal Python 3.13 output, read-only Git-free export, warning-as-error source compilation, Ruff checks and all 34 committed-file byte comparisons pass locally. All 17 reused source Git blobs are authenticated. Internal read-only mathematics/artifact reviews found no scientific or code blocker; hosted CI and independent human review remain separate.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/rank7-native-a-format`. The README supplies external-output commands. Canonical main remains `d8e0f83f`, priority revision 6; live overlap was refreshed before submission. Exact head: `4a5ce834638534a5bfab1b5169c4a7210b2c0656`.

Credit PR3086/3083/3084, PR3076/3078/3060/3056, dcharb78/PR3042, Jeremy Kothe/PR3015, Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979, Cinna Davis/PR2226, DLamdata, icekylinx, Tekalign and the retained native/geometry/owner lineage. Frozen notices and source bytes are unchanged. Development used substantial automated assistance; no independent human review is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

One opt-in research package. Exact adapter endpoints, scalar lowering, later consumers, recursive defects, ownership/routing, clean stock and the complete supplier/outer invoice remain separate obligations. No selected frontier, shared compiler, frozen predecessor or other PR is changed.
